sources.excerpt: TC Electronic MojoMojo Overdrive – Pedal Wiki Pedal Wiki Guitar effect pedal database TC Electronic MojoMojo Overdrive MojoMojo is an analog overdrive pedal by TC Electronic. It is designed to sound like an amp, to preserve dynamic of the original playing and maintain clarity even in complex chords. MojoMojo features four knobs and one switch Drive knob (controls gain) Level (output stage attenuator) Bass (High-pass EQ) Treble Internally, MojoMojo circuit is nearly the same as the Dark Matter with slight changes: Voice input does not alter frequency response but only changes pre-gain signal level (analog of turning down the volume knob on guitar). Wider tone control Lower pre-gain signal boost Higher gain range Higher post-gain boost Source: Traced schematic of MojoMojo by DraftYeti5608 on Reddit. Sound demo by TC Electronic The list of artists endorsing MojoMojo includes Tom Hamilton of Aerosmith and Scott Ian of Anthrax. Paul Gilbert is also a known user of the pedal and even has his signature edition released by TC Electronic in 2021: Type: Overdrive Analog True bypass Inputs: 1 x 6.25mm (1 x 1/4″) TS Outputs: 1 x 6.25mm (1 x 1/4″) TS Dimensions: 72 x 122 x 50 mm Power consumption: 9V Polarity: center-negative In production since: April 2011 Analogs: Ibanez TS9 TubeScreamer , Boss OD-1X OverDrive Page on the manufacturer’s site Shops: Thomann , Reverb
